name: gg.keyfinder/price-lookup
title: Keyfinder price lookup
description: Cheapest game key and gift card prices from the key shops Keyfinder compares, with Steam's price.

tools.name: find_game_price
tools.description: The cheapest key for one PC or console game at the 17 shops Keyfinder compares: price, shop, platform, region and edition of the cheapest key in stock that activates in Germany and the EU (PC and the standard edition first, as the game's page shows it), Steam's own price and the saving where known, how many offers and shops were compared, when the prices were read, and the game's page. Where a shop sells an account with the game on it, cheapest_account gives that price apart: it is an account, not a key. With country set to US, CA, AU, NZ, SG, JP, KR, BR, MX, AR, CL, CO, GB it also gives the cheapest key that activates there, in that country's currency too, and the country's page. Use it when someone asks where a game is cheapest, what its key costs or whether it costs less than on Steam. Prices are in euros, read within the last few hours, as the game's page shows them: where a shop's discount code lowers a price, price_eur counts it in and discount_code gives the code to enter at the shop's checkout and the price without it. Some shops add a fee at checkout. If the game isn't the one meant, other_matches lists up to four others. Read-only; Keyfinder records the call (tool, arguments and time).

game.description: The game's title, English works best, e.g. Elden Ring.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code for prices there: US, CA, AU, NZ, SG, JP, KR, BR, MX, AR, CL, CO, GB. Other codes get the price for Germany and the EU.

tools.name: gift_card_prices
tools.description: What gift cards, store credit, subscriptions and in-game currency cost at key shops: PlayStation Store, Xbox, Steam, Nintendo, PlayStation Plus, Game Pass, Apple, Google Play, V-Bucks, Robux, FC Points and more. Per size (up to 12, or the one matching amount): the face value or amount, the cheapest price in euros and its shop, the percent below the face value (negative when above), the number of offers and the size's page. The cards are for accounts in Germany, the EU and worldwide, unless country names one of the countries Keyfinder lists cards for (FR, BE, NL, ES, IT, AT, PT, IE, FI, GR, LU, GB, US, PL, CH, CZ, RO, HU, SK, BG, HR, CA, MX, BR, AU, NZ, AR, CL, CO, IN, SG, JP, KR, for store credit and console subscriptions). Use it when someone asks what a card costs or where it is cheapest. Prices are in euros, read within the last few hours, as the size's page shows them: where a shop's discount code lowers a price, price_eur counts it in and discount_code gives the code and the price without it. Read-only; Keyfinder records the call (tool, arguments and time).

brand.description: The card or currency, e.g. psn, xbox, steam, nintendo, v-bucks, robux, fc points.

country.description: Optional two-letter code of the account's country, e.g. US or GB. Default: Germany.

amount.description: Optional size: 50 for a 50 euro or 50 dollar card, 1000 for 1,000 V-Bucks, 12 for 12 months.
